2610.03935.title: General Decision Models: Benchmarking and Insights Beyond Jev
2610.03935.paper_summary: General decision models, such as Jev, have recently emerged as efficient alternatives to LLMs for structured judgment and selection. But what kinds of decisions can these models reliably make, and how does their behavior change when individual decisions are composed into larger systems? To study this, we introduce JEVal, a bilingual benchmark comprising 11,257 instances from 36 datasets across 10 application domains, and evaluate 25 model configurations spanning general decision models and generative LLMs. Our results show that (1) general decision models are most competitive when decisions can be resolved from available evidence, but weaken when they require specialist knowledge or faithful uncertainty estimation: they can often identify the most likely outcome while substantially overstating its probability. (2) In more dynamic and realistic systems involving long-horizon, multi-step interactions, the advantages of fast local decision making are offset by reliability failures at the system level. on $τ$-bench, faster local decisions reduce median episode time but lower task success as decision errors accumulate over long trajectories. (3) In large-scale social simulation, decision models approach strong generative LLMs on individual response prediction at substantially lower inference cost, yet remain weaker in user profiling and exhibit larger aggregate estimation errors and systematic bias. Finally, we propose InnerJev-4B and InnerJev-27B, which internalize an open-weight LLM's own reasoning into a single-pass first-token decision through Reasoning-to-Readout Self-Distillation, with InnerJev-27B performing on par with Jev on JEVal while answering a typical query in about 0.1 s.
2610.03935.paper_summary_zh: 一般決策模型，如Jev，最近作為結構化判斷和選擇的高效替代方案出現。<lb/>但這些模型能可靠地做出什麼樣的決策？當個別決策組合成更大的系統時，它們的行為又會如何改變？<lb/>為了研究這一點，我們介紹了JEVal，一個雙語基準，包含來自36個數據集的11,257個實例，涵蓋10個應用領域，並評估了25種模型配置，涵蓋一般決策模型和生成式LLMs。<lb/>我們的結果顯示：(1) 當決策可以從可用證據中解決時，一般決策模型的競爭力最強，但當它們需要專業知識或準確的不確定性估計時則會減弱：它們通常能識別出最可能的結果，但會大幅高估其概率。<lb/>(2) 在涉及長期、多步互動的更動態和現實的系統中，快速本地決策的優勢被系統層面的可靠性失敗所抵消。在$τ$-bench上，更快的本地決策減少了中位數事件時間，但隨著決策錯誤在長軌跡中累積，任務成功率降低。<lb/>(3) 在大規模社會模擬中，決策模型在個體反應預測上接近強大的生成式LLMs，且推理成本大幅降低，但在用戶檔案分析上仍然較弱，並顯示出較大的總體估計誤差和系統性偏差。<lb/>最後，我們提出了InnerJev-4B和InnerJev-27B，通過推理到讀出自我蒸餾，將開放權重LLM自身的推理內化為單次通過的首個令牌決策，其中InnerJev-27B在JEVal上表現與Jev相當，並在約0.1秒內回答典型查詢。
